summary: An open PIM Manager page keeps its sign-in fresh, refused calls name who sent them, and a role deleted in a workload no longer fails every run.

fixes.title: Sign-in stays fresh on an open page
fixes.text: The page renews its sign-in before it ends. When renewal is not possible, it stops its background calls and shows the sign-in bar once, instead of trying every minute.

fixes.title: Refused calls say who and from where
fixes.text: A refused call is logged with the signed-in user, the address it came from and the browser type, at most once per 10 minutes. The token itself is never logged.

fixes.title: A role deleted in the workload
fixes.text: When a role that PIM Manager had assigned is deleted in the workload, the row shows a calm warning (delete the row or recreate the role) instead of failing every run.
